paper.title: Proposal for a micromagnetic standard problem for materials with Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction
paper.figure: Fig. 1a / Table I - one-dimensional edge tilting, interfacial DMI

alpha.why: not stated; the problem is static, so damping only sets how fast Relax() converges, not the answer

initial_state.why: not stated; along the stated easy axis

numerics.EnableDemag: false - the paper states it does not include the demagnetising field in this problem (p.7), and its Eq. 5 energy has no magnetostatic term
numerics.OpenBC: true - the paper's boundary condition (Eq. 11, dTheta/dx = 1/xi) is the free-spin condition; mumax3's default closed boundary gives a different edge tilt
numerics.cell_m: refined below the stated 1 nm to show convergence

targets.name: edge tilt m_z
targets.source: paper Eq. 12, sin(Theta)=Delta/xi with Delta=sqrt(A/Ku)=5.70 nm, xi=2A/D=8.667 nm -> Theta=41.13 deg, m_z=cos(Theta)

targets.name: centre stays uniform
targets.source: the tilt decays over Delta=5.7 nm, so the middle of a 100 nm wire is unperturbed
